newsitem.title: UK: Laporte shares indicated up after yr result.
newsitem.headline: Laporte shares indicated up after yr result.

text.p: Shares in British speciality chemicals company Laporte Plc were indicated higher on Monday after the company reported a 12 percent rise in profits, ahead of forecasts.

The shares were indicated 16-1/2 pence up at 685 by 0810 GMT in premarket trade after Laporte said pretax profits before exceptionals rose to 127 million stg, above expectations of between 114.3 million to 124 million stg.
The results increase came after Laporte simplified its group structure and closed or sold about 34 percent of its operating units to boost 1996 performance.
The company paid out a total dividend of 24.25 pence per share, up five percent and above forecasts of 23.5 to 24.0 pence per share.
Laporte has also seen some interest from buyers in its U.S. adhesives businesses, chief executive Jim Leng told Reuters in an interview.
"We are looking at some initial expressions of interest for North American adhesives," Leng said.
